method: Derived a dependency-only invocation from the exact PAL module Ninja command; removed object/header output flags and redirected the module cache to a temporary directory. No compile or link actions were invoked; candidate 139 and recovered build outputs were not modified.

observations.diagnosticSummary: Clang dependency scans rejected cached PCM/PCH configuration mismatches and several SDK Swift interface dependencies could not resolve. The driver exited 0 despite diagnostics, and emitted only a partial graph; result is not a pass.

decision: Do not reuse this as compiler/module dependency closure. Do not repeat the same PAL scan with the same transformed invocation. A trustworthy closure needs a scan configuration that matches WebKit PCH/Clang importer settings, or a different authoritative build-system dependency source.
